entry: Existing frozen first completed 3H parent turn at next 15m RTH opening
signal: Exactly one check at completed 0.5 or 3.0 observed RTH hours; sell remainder if completed five-minute close is below actual entry price
additional_slippage_formula: Applied only to an actual check-triggered discretionary sale, exactly its filled remaining-share quantity q * observed early-sale opening price / entry price * (bps/100) as net percentage points. Does not affect unrelated risk-stop exits.
transaction_assumptions: Base engine 5bp/side already included, 25% sold at+2% when modeled, 1.5% stop always first, maximum 52 observed RTH hours; slippage stress additional.
source_gaps: Read baseline and tested original source, no fill through KLAC missing 5m spans. Retain unknown separately, never count as zero.
metrics: additional adverse execution cost when quote unknown
controls: one 5m next-open matches v21 original exactly, independently within .000002 pp; no threshold/timing selection after outcome
